title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
abstract: arXiv:2610.33645v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GUI grounding requires locating small controls in cluttered screenshots and identifying which control a natural-language instruction refers to. Cropping and enlargement can expose local detail, but the resulting image may still leave ambiguity about the intended target. We propose PreView, an auxiliary preprocessor that improves the inputs to an existing grounding model without further training that model. PreView prepares two complementary types of input features: task-relevant views for localization and candidate-specific cues for target understanding. A trained lightweight auxiliary model predicts and refines a center, crops the screenshot into a local view, and enlarges that view for zoomed-in grounding. It also prepares a visual cue (i.e., a red-circle marker with a location hint) and a textual cue describing the candidate's identity or function. The frozen grounding model uses the prepared inputs to predict the final click. Acros

translated_title: PreView：利用预处理的视图与线索增强GUI定位
translated_abstract: GUI定位（GUI grounding）需要在杂乱的截图中定位小型控件，并识别自然语言指令所指的是哪个控件。裁剪和放大可以暴露局部细节，但所得图像可能仍会让目标控件存在歧义。我们提出PreView，一个辅助预处理模块，它可以在无需进一步训练现有定位模型的情况下改进其输入。PreView准备两类互补的输入特征：用于定位的任务相关视图，以及用于目标理解的候选特定线索。一个经过训练的轻量级辅助模型预测并精修中心点，将截图裁剪为局部视图，并放大该视图以实现放大后的定位。它还准备一个视觉线索（即带有位置提示的红圈标记）和一个描述候选控件身份或功能的文本线索。被冻结的定位模型使用这些准备好的输入来预测最终的点击位置。在……（摘要原文此处被截断）
tldr: PreView通过一个轻量级辅助预处理模型为冻结的GUI定位模型生成任务相关的局部放大视图以及视觉与文本线索，无需重新训练模型即可提升GUI定位的准确性。
en_tdlr: PreView employs a lightweight auxiliary preprocessor that provides a frozen GUI grounding model with task-relevant zoomed-in views and visual/textual cues, improving grounding accuracy without retraining the model.
